ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: an old illness
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} nearly died of the wasting sickness as a young adult, and spent a year in a sanatorium coughing into a cloth. The doctors called it cured. Every winter cough since, {PAWN_pronoun} has been certain it was coming back, and has hidden every one.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} nearly died of the wasting sickness as a young adult, and spent a year shut in a sickhouse coughing into a cloth. The healers called it cured. Every winter cough since, {PAWN_pronoun} has been certain it was coming back, and has hidden every one.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} sat with {B_nameDef} in the infirmary long after the patients were asleep, talking quietly. {B_nameDef} came out looking thoughtful and hasn't said why.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {PAWN_nameDef} dreaded every winter here, {TELLER_nameDef} said, and not because of the cold.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a fear of deep water
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} cannot swim, and is so afraid of deep water that {PAWN_pronoun} takes the long way round every pond. A boat went down under {PAWN_objective} once, and {PAWN_pronoun} was the only one pulled out.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} walked down to the water's edge together, and {A_nameDef} stopped a good way short of it. They talked there for a long time.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} asked for {PAWN_nameDef}'s grave to be dug well away from the water.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a fortune told
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: When {PAWN_nameDef} was young, a fortune teller at a fair took {PAWN_possessive} hand and named the winter {PAWN_pronoun} would die in. {PAWN_nameDef} has counted the winters ever since, and that one is not far off now.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} how many winters it had been since a certain year, and when {B_nameDef} worked it out, told {B_objective} why it mattered.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} counted the winters off on {TELLER_possessive} fingers at the graveside, and then told the others what {PAWN_nameDef} had once been promised.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a lost caravan
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} once guarded a trading house's caravan that raiders took on the road, every crate and every animal. {PAWN_nameDef} was the only one to walk away untouched, and the house is sure {PAWN_pronoun} sold the route to the raiders. They still want their goods paid for.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} drew a road on the table for {B_nameDef} with a wet finger, and talked {B_objective} through it, stop by stop. Neither of them would say what it was about.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} swore to the end that {PAWN_pronoun} never sold anyone out, and told the rest:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the farm lost at cards
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef}'s family had a good farm with a stone house, three generations old, until {PAWN_nameDef} lost it in one night of cards, and left before morning so {PAWN_pronoun} wouldn't have to tell them.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} turned down a friendly game of cards again, and this time told {B_nameDef} the reason, out by the fields where no one could hear.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} put a playing card in the grave with {PAWN_nameDef}, face down, and explained:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a miracle tonic
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} once sold a miracle tonic from the back of a cart: colored water, a little alcohol and a lot of talk, at a price that would have bought real medicine twice over. Some of the people who bought it were very sick.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} watched {B_nameDef} sort the medicine for a while, then said something that made {B_nameDef} set the bottle down. They talked until the lamp guttered.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} always tidied the medicine shelf as if it owed {PAWN_objective} something, and told the others what it was:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a hidden purse
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} has a purse of silver hidden under a loose stone by {PAWN_possessive} bed, put by a coin at a time "for when it all goes wrong." It's been there through every lean week the colony has had.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} has a purse of coins hidden under a loose stone by {PAWN_possessive} bed, put by one at a time "for when it all goes wrong." It's been there through every lean week the colony has had.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} lifted a stone by the bed to show {B_nameDef} something, then put it back very carefully.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} went to {PAWN_nameDef}'s bed after the burial and lifted a loose stone. Then {TELLER_pronoun} explained:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: raised in the camps
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} grew up in the drifters' camps that trail along behind armies and caravans, and lived by stealing from both. To this day {PAWN_nameDef} counts the doors in any room and sleeps with {PAWN_possessive} boots on.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} pointed out the fires of a camp on the horizon to {B_nameDef}, and talked for a long time without looking away from them.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} took {PAWN_nameDef}'s boots off for the burial. In all {PAWN_possessive} years here, no one had ever seen {PAWN_objective} without them.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: thrown out of the workshop
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was thrown out of a master's workshop on the last day of a seven-year apprenticeship, for ruining the piece the master had promised to a lord. {PAWN_nameDef} never got the papers, and has been quietly pretending to have them ever since.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} an old, half-finished piece of work wrapped in cloth, and told {B_objective} the story of it. {B_nameDef} handled it as if it might break.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} buried {PAWN_nameDef} with a half-finished piece of work wrapped in cloth, and told the others the story of it:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a wedding walked out on
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was meant to be married once, and walked out of the wedding halfway through the vows, with the whole family watching. {PAWN_nameDef} never went back, never wrote and never explained, and still doesn't know why {PAWN_pronoun} did it.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} went very quiet at the mention of a wedding, and later that evening told {B_nameDef} why. {B_nameDef} let {A_objective} talk.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} once told {TELLER_objective} about the one promise {PAWN_pronoun} never kept:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a broken vow
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} took holy vows once, for life, and broke them inside a year: climbed over the cloister wall one night and never went back. The order still keeps {PAWN_possessive} name on its list of the lost, and prays for {PAWN_objective} every evening.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} sat with {B_nameDef} at dusk, when {A_pronoun} usually goes off alone, and said a few words {B_nameDef} didn't recognize. Then {A_pronoun} explained them.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said a prayer over {PAWN_nameDef} that none of the others had heard before, and then told them where {PAWN_pronoun} had learned it:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: banished by vote
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was banished from {PAWN_possessive} home town by a vote of its council, for a theft from the common store. {PAWN_nameDef} has always said it wasn't {PAWN_objective}, and has never once missed a vote here.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: After a council meeting, {A_nameDef} stayed behind with {B_nameDef} and told {B_objective} something about another council, a long way from here.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} would want it known, now, why {PAWN_pronoun} cared so much about a fair vote:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the fire that took the street
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: The fire that burned down {PAWN_nameDef}'s old street started in {PAWN_possessive} own kitchen, a pot left on too long. A neighbor took the blame and was driven out for it, and {PAWN_nameDef} never said a word.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} banked the kitchen fire for the night, then checked it twice more, then sat down with {B_nameDef} and explained why {A_pronoun} always does.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: The night after the burial, {TELLER_nameDef} banked the kitchen fire and then checked it twice more, the way {PAWN_nameDef} always had.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: dancing in the empty hall
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} dances. When everyone else is asleep, {PAWN_pronoun} goes to the empty hall and dances alone, without music, the old steps from a stage {PAWN_pronoun} hasn't stood on in years. The night watch has known for months and never said.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} to come to the hall late at night, and the two of them weren't seen again until morning. {B_nameDef} came to breakfast with sore feet and wouldn't say why.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} went to the empty hall the night after the burial and stood there for a while. In the morning {TELLER_pronoun} told the others what {PAWN_nameDef} used to do there:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the little carvings
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} is the one who has been leaving little carved animals on people's pillows: a fox for the one who was sad, a bird for the one who was ill, a bear for the one who came home hurt. There is one for nearly everyone by now, and nobody knew who made them.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} pressed something small into {B_nameDef}'s hand and made {B_objective} promise not to tell anyone where it came from.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} set a little carved animal on {PAWN_nameDef}'s grave, the last one {PAWN_pronoun} ever made, and told the others who had made all the rest:
